(1)༄༅/ /zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyil mkhyer byin rlabs dngos grub kyi 'byung gnas yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/༄༅/ /ji skad du/ma

tei:div.tei:p: (1)༄༅// zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyil mkhyer byin rlabs dngos grub kyi 'byung gnas yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ ༄༅// ji skad du/ mos gus yod na byin rlabs yod/ dbyin rlabs yod na nyams rtogs yod// zhes bas bla ma dam pa bsten pa tsam gyi chog mi shes par bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bcos min zhig med na rang gi mthong tshul las byin rlabs dang dngos grub khyad par can skye dka' bas/ des na bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'di shes kyis/ skyabs sems sdon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ aḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i steng// tsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje gzi brjid rtsal// lam mchog yongs rdzogs theg rtse'i (2)༄༅// snang ba yis// skal bzang dmigs bu bgyid la dgyes pa'i zhal// mtshan dpe gzi 'bar paṇ+ḍita yi chas/ srid zhir mi gnas skyil krud drang por zhugs// g.yas g.yon phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu ni// srid dang zhi ba mnyam pa nyid gzigs pa// thugs rje rgyal ba las kyang lhag par brtses/ bdag blo mos pa'i zhing du 'byon bgyi nas// grangs med zhing bzhugs rgyal dang sems pa'i tshogs// bsod nams bye ba'i zhing du bzhugs su gsol// rgyal kun thugs kyi gsang ba rdo rje'i dbyings// gang du khyed dgyes chos sku'i rgyal khab nas// g.yo med mtha' klas 'gro ba'i blo mtsho na/ gzugs sku'i rnam rol grangs med chu zla ltar// 'gogs med cir yang 'char la phyag 'tshal lo// srid na dregs pa'i snyems 'char rgyags ldan brgya'i// do ker nor bu'i 'od kyis dmar byas rdul// khyed zhabs pad+mo'i ngo mtshar gyis bzung ba// lha mi'i ston pa mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// thog mar log sreng 'khor ba'i 'ching ba bkrol// bar du zhi dga' dman pa'i g.yang las skyob/ mthar thugs theg mchog gdams pa'i bcud stsol ba// tshangs pa'i dbyings dang ldan la phyag 'tshal lo// nang rgyud sde

(3)༄༅// gsum bdud rtsi mgros rgyun// 'babs mkhas bdag po so zur gnubs gsum gyi// byin rlabs 'od stong yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mkhar// rgud pa'i mun sel bshes gnyen la phyag 'tshal// lam mchog byang chub sems kyi thugs rgyud gtams// rgyal pa sras bcas dgyes ba'i lam bzang po// snyigs dus 'di nag dul bya'i 'gro ba la// brtse bas mngon sum 'dom la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig nyer len srid pa'i rgyan zad kyang// ye shes thugs rje'i snang ba 'byams klas bas// mkhyen gnyis ye shes rdzogs pa bcom ldan 'das// mgon po mchog brnyes khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod pa rgya chen kun tu bzang pa'i sprin// rgyal sras spyod mchog mu mtha' mi gtug pa// lus dang longs spyod dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs// bka' drin mtshungs med khyed la mchod pa 'bul// bdag gis thog med bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang// bcas dang rang bzhin nyes pa ci ches pa// gnong 'gyod mos pa'i sems kyis bshags bgyid na// dag cing tshangs pa'i zhal ras bstan du gsol// kun mkhyen rgyal ba gnyis pa'i rang lugs ni// gzhung bzang stong gi chu bo 'dus pa'i mtsho// bshad dang sgrub pa'i khur chen 'dzin bzod pa// rlabs chen phrin las mdzad la rjes yi rang// mdo sngags gzhung mang rgyal ba'i lam gcig tu// sdud pa'i tshul gyis rnam mang 'jug pa'i sgo// ji snyid mi 'gal gdams par 'char nus pa// zab dang rgya che'i chos 'khor bskor du gsol// rgyal ba gnyis pa klu sgrub yab sras dang// rgyal tshab mi pham mgon dang thog med kyi// legs bshad lam (4)༄༅// bzang rtog gis ma bslad pa'i// rang lugs gsal ba'i nyin byed rtags bar bzhugs// bdag gi ji snyed bsags pa'i dge tsa 'dis// bsgyud pa gsum gyi man ngag bdud rtsi'i klung// gang yang byang chub sems su ro gcig pas// lta dang sgom dang spyod pa rnam dag nas// mtha' bral zab mo'i gnas lugs rtogs par shog// ces dang gzhan yang spro na ji snyed su dag sogs yan lag bdun brgyas pa'ang bya'o// rnam mkhyen rigs kyi sa bon bskrun pa'i pha bla ma mkhyen no// phyin drug lam gyi mdon rtogs skyed pa'i ma bla ma mkhyen no// sku bzhi'i go 'phang gi rgyal thabs sbyin pa'i rdo rje slob dpon mkhyen no// mthar thug chos sku'i pha phog ster ba'i rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin can mkhyen no// byin rlabs khyed la med na su la yod// dngos grub khyed la mi re su la re// gsol ba ngas mi 'debs na su yis 'debs// thugs rjes khyed kyis mi gzigs na su yis gzigs// bla ma mkhyen no// bla ma mkhyen no// pha bla ma mkhyen no// ma bla ma mkhyen no// sa mchog dkyil 'khor mngon gyur bi ma la// kun bzang chos sku'i ston pa klong chen pa// dbyer med ngag gi dbang por gsol ba 'debs// thugs yid dbyer med 'dres bar byin gyis rlobs// dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/

sogs dang// bdag ni deng nas skye ba kun tu yang// dpal ldan bla ma khyed kyi bran gyur nas// lus dang longs spyod dge ba kun spung te// nyams thag ma rgan kun gyi g.yog bgyid shog// rnam dag tshul khrim gtsang mas rgyud sdom zhing// rin chen byang chub sems la blo 'byongs nas// shing rta gnyis kyi rang lugs ji bzhin du// thos bsam bsgom ba'i shes rab (5)༄༅// dri med kyis// 'chad rtsod rtsom pas rgyal bstan spel ba la// bdud dang bar chad mi mthun kun zhi zhing// mthun rkyen smon ba yid bzhin 'grub nas su// rgyal pa'i bstan pa ring du gnas gyur cig// de yi mthu las yangs pa'i rgyal khams su// rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dga' ston gong 'phel nas// bslab ldan mang thos dge 'dun rin chen gyis// 'dzin ma'i khyon kun yongs su rgyas par shog// ces sogs bsdob smon lam ci 'grub pas thar rgyas bar bya'o// thun mongs nas bzung theg rtse'i bar// lam mkhan bshes gnyen mgon la brten las 'byung// de bas bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi// lam zab 'di la 'bad pa thon// tse cig brtson pas nyams blad na// chos phung brgyad khri'i snying po 'du// mdo sngags lam gyi srog rtsa 'dus// bden rdzun rgyal ba'i lung la dris// zhes pa 'ang lcags mo rong nas byon pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs dang/ o rgyan bstan 'dzin dang// sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin gsum gyi bskul ngor// byin rlabs bla ma nyag gcig la re ba mang du thos pa rgyal sras 'bang las 'brel rtsal gyis sug bris su bstan pa legs kyi snang ba chen pos phyogs kun tu khyab par gyur cig gu// rig 'dzin bla ma bde gshegs zhi khro dang// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung dam tshig can// dpang gyur mgon po ye shes spyan mnga' ba// dkun mkhyen gsal ba'i dgongs pa bla na med// thugs rjes dngos grub byin rlabs rgya mcho'i bdag// bdag gi nongs pa bshags la dgongs su gsol// ngang nyid ye nas sangs rgyas yin mod kyang// rtog pa'i dbang gis 'khor ba 'dir

(6)༄༅// 'khyams nas// las dang nyon mongs bzod dka' yun ring mnar// rgyun ring shug drags rtog pa'i rba rlabs g.yo// sdug bsngal sna tshogs dbang gis nyams re thag// 'di la skyabs dang skyobs pa mdzad du gsol// bdag ni thog ma med nas da lta'i bar// nyon mongs 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug zhing// nga rgyal phrag dog 'khrul ba'i kun bslad nas// srog bcod ma byin blang dang mi tshang spyod// rdzun tshig phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal dang// brnab sems gnod sems log par lta ba dang// mtshams med snga dang de dang nye ba lnga// lci bzhi log brgyad kha na ma tho ba'i// sdig pa bgyid dang rtsal yi rangs pa'i// rang bzhin mi dge sdig pa ci mchis pa// skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i sbyan sdar mthol lo bshags// mi gsang mi sbed gnong 'gyod drag pos bshags// phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi bgyid do// pham pa bzhi dang lhag ma bcu gsum dang// spang ltud sum cu ltung byed dgu bcu dang// sor bshags bzhing dang nye byes brgya bcu gnyis// so thar 'dul ba'i bde gshegs bcas las 'gal// sdig stung mi dge so sor bshags par bgyid// rtsa ltung nye shu nyes byas bcu phrag brgyad// dkar nag chos brgyad glang dor nyams pa dang// rtsa ba'i ltung ba bzhi dang yan lag gi// nyes byas bzhi bcu zhe drug la sogs pa'i// rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i gnang bkags kyi// mtshams las 'gal ba'i nyes ltung ci mchis pa// mi gsang mi sbed gnod 'gyod drag pos bshags// brtul zhugs nyer lnga rtsa ltung bcu bzhi dang// yan lag sbom po'i ltung ba rnams pa brgyad// khyad par (7)༄༅ rdzogs pa chen po'i dam tshig ni// nyi shu tsa bdun tsa ba'i ltung ba dang// yan lag da ma tshig nyi shu tsa lnga dang// lhag pa'i dam tshig chen po nyi shu ste// bya spyod rnam 'byor bla na med pa yi// dam tshig nyams chags mi dge sdig pa'i tshogs// gnong 'gyod drag pos mthol bshegs ba zod par gsol// bdag ni sems can 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin lags// mi shes dbang gis nyes pa ci mchis pa// don dam ye shes mnga' ba'i lha la bshags// brtse ba'i dbang gi bzod pa dang du zhes// dag cing tshangs pa'i dgyes pa'i zhal res ston// phyin chad mi bgyid dam bca' khyed la 'bul// rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs rmad byung gis// bdag rgyud yongs su dag par byin gyis rlobs// ces pa 'di ni guṇi'i ming gis skul ngor dug lda'i me lce dbyings su 'khyil ba'i tsha zer can sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa las 'brel rtsal gyis bris pa dge'o//
